title: Example: a day with an evening run

steps.label:
Run planned for 17:30 today: Vana speaks first
about fuelling it (moment 1)

70-minute run finished, nothing logged since:
she speaks first about recovery (moment 2)

Two moments used: she says nothing more today,
and never twice for the same workout

A cook-day check-in comes as the opener
when the app next opens, not as a moment
